leadIn.title: Lead-In & Context: Telling the Time
leadIn.content: Asking for the time: What time is it? It is half past three, or three thirty.

form.title: Form & Structure: Telling the Time
form.content: Digital: It is + hour + minute (It's 3:30). Analog: It's + minute + past/to + hour (quarter past four, ten to six, half past two).

controlledPractice.question: 3:15 in words?
controlledPractice.explanation: 15 minutes past the hour is 'quarter past'.

controlledPractice.question: 3:45 in words?
controlledPractice.explanation: 45 minutes past 3 is the same as 15 minutes before 4: quarter to four.

controlledPractice.question: US date order for 5/7/2026?
controlledPractice.explanation: The US writes month/day/year, so 5/7 means month 5 (May) and day 7 (7th May).
